meta.title: [WIP] Streaming still not working. Causing slow responses for something like 'write a report' #981
meta.body_summary: Fix streaming real-time output in PraisonAI agents; adds StreamableResponse class to enable chunked iteration when stream=True, addressing issue where responses were accumulated internally.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot streaming fix without maintainer review; closed after 7 days of inactivity, no formal validation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 244 added lines in a single file, this is a small-to-medium change. As a streaming performance fix, it was closed without merge due to lack of review and validation.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review submitted; PR comments only from Copilot and bot. Owner requested Claude review, but Claude encountered an error and no human follow-up occurred.
review_details.performance_claim: Fix streaming to deliver real-time chunked output instead of internal accumulation, reducing user-perceived latency.
review_details.rejection_signals: No maintainer review; closed after ~7 days. Owner requested Claude review but Claude encountered an error; no human follow-up.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent required human review and integration testing for a latency-sensitive feature; without maintainer engagement, the PR could not be merged.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes repro steps from the original issue, but no validation of the fix was performed. Copilot reported firewall restrictions preventing full integration tests.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no regression testing or fix cycle occurred.

core_change_summary.description: In src/praisonai-agents/praisonaiagents/agent/agent.py, added StreamableResponse class that supports both iteration and string operations, implemented _chat_stream() method for real-time chunked output when stream=True, while preserving backward compatibility for non-streaming usage.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes are confined to a single file with 244 additions; no test files or configuration changes included.
